name: Tome of Divinity
summary: In Dun Morogh, Azar Stronghammer calls young dwarven paladins away from their field duties and sends them to Ironforge. He directs each initiate to Tiza Battleforge in the Hall of Mysteries for guidance, beginning deeper trials in service to the Holy Light.

sections.title: A Call to the High Seat
sections.body: Dwarven initiates begin by guarding Dun Morogh's snowbound villages and roads. When Azar Stronghammer sees that a defender is ready for deeper spiritual instruction, he sends the promising candidate from field duties to Ironforge. There, the initiate can seek guidance from the city's holy elders.

sections.title: The Hall of Mysteries
sections.body: The summons leads you to the Mystic Ward, then up to the Hall of Mysteries. Tiza Battleforge waits there, upstairs among sacred relics and solemn study. A respected dwarven champion of the Light, she tests whether you are ready for self-sacrifice, mercy, and the moral duties of your calling.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
aliases: why do i need this quest
what is tome of divinity for
faq.answer: It calls a dwarven paladin away from field duties in Dun Morogh and directs you to Tiza Battleforge in Ironforge. The trials are required to understand the Holy Light and earn the power of resurrection.

Tiza Battleforge is a veteran dwarven paladin and respected mentor stationed upstairs in Ironforge's Hall of Mysteries. She guides young paladins in spiritual instruction and the sacred trials of the Tome of Divinity.

faq.q: Where is the Hall of Mysteries located?
faq.answer: The Hall of Mysteries is in the Mystic Ward in western Ironforge. It is the spiritual and arcane center of the dwarven capital, where priests, paladins, and mages gather.

faq.q: Who sends the paladin on this errand?
faq.answer: Azar Stronghammer, a paladin trainer in Dun Morogh, sends promising initiates to Ironforge after they show their dedication to defending local dwarven settlements.

faq.q: Why must dwarven paladins study in Ironforge?
faq.answer: Azar teaches basic combat in the field, while the Hall of Mysteries holds the formal teachings, sacred texts, and elders of the Holy Light. Advanced rites and spiritual doctrines are studied under senior mentors such as Tiza Battleforge.

faq.q: What follows after speaking with Tiza Battleforge?
aliases: next quest after tome of divinity
faq.answer: Speaking with Tiza begins the true dwarven trials of the Tome of Divinity. They challenge you to show devotion, compassion, and sacrifice in service to the Light.

angles.text: As a paladin, this rite bridges practical military service in the snows with the deep spiritual discipline expected of holy warriors.
As a dwarf, you join the endurance of your kin with the teachings of the Holy Light, centered in Ironforge's Hall of Mysteries.
As an Alliance member, you share reverence for the Light with dwarven defenders of Khaz Modan and your human allies in Lordaeron and Stormwind.
